test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the INCORRECT statement for the universal law of gravitation.

options.text: It is the force that binds us to earth
It is the force causing tides due to the stars and earth
It is the forces that assists motion of the moon around earth
It is the force keeps motion of planets around the Sun

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is the force causing tides due to the stars and earth.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The phenomenons explained by the universal law of gravitation:
 
 
• **The force that binds us to the earth.**
 
• **The motion of the moon around the earth.**
 
• **The motion of planets around the Sun.**
 
• **The tides due to the moon and the Sun.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Universal Law of gravitation was formulated by **Sir Issac Newton in the year 1687.**
 
• Newton used the universal law of gravity to prove that the moon is accelerating towards Earth just as a body on Earth is falling towards Earth.
 
• According to the Universal law of gravitation, **the force between two bodies is directly proportional to their masses and inversely proportional to a square of the distance.**
